description: Approved GreenLedger v1 mapping rules. Classification is deterministic only when required boundary context is present; otherwise return an ambiguous/unresolved status for human review. AI may extract context but cannot invent categories.

conditions: Electricity is purchased or acquired and consumed in the organization's operation.
mappings.notes: The accounting method (location-based/market-based) is separate from the scope/category label. Current CEA source values are CO2-only and do not enable CO2e calculation.

mappings.scope_when_not_controlled_or_not_combust: unresolved; determine applicable Scope 3 treatment from actual activity and organizational boundary
required_context: whether quantity is consumed or merely purchased
mappings.notes: A diesel invoice alone does not determine combustion, source class, or organizational control. Do not assign Scope 1 or a Scope 3 category from the fuel label alone.

mappings.scope_when_not_controlled_or_not_combust: unresolved; determine applicable Scope 3 treatment from actual activity and organizational boundary
required_context: whether quantity is consumed or merely purchased
commercial/institutional stationary source classification when selecting the conditional global IPCC Tier 1 factor
mappings.notes: Do not infer net gas mass from cylinder count alone or assign a scope from an LPG invoice alone. The retained global IPCC Tier 1 candidate is pending independent revalidation and is not currently calculable, even for commercial/institutional stationary combustion (IPCC 1.A.4.a) with verified net mass; other contexts require a matching approved factor.

conditions: The item is within the approved GreenLedger material subset.
The factor represents upstream cradle-to-gate production, not separately counted transport.
mappings.notes: The approved GreenLedger v1 subset is only PPC cement, steel rebars, and generic steel. Identity is required and ambiguity requires human review. The selected CPWD references are generic/reference factors, not supplier-specific EPD lookups; the CPWD table's underlying source remarks remain in factor provenance. Monetary amounts are not physical activity data.

conditions: reporting company purchased the transportation/distribution service
third-party transportation of sold products after the point of sale
transportation service was not purchased by reporting company
vehicles/facilities are owned or controlled by reporting company

required_context: verified mass and distance or tonne-km
mappings.notes: Only India road freight is supported, using explicit SFC India/TERI vehicle class, shipment mass, and distance. Category 4/9 remains determined by the existing business-flow rules; company-controlled transport remains Scope 1 and cannot use these Scope 3 freight intensities. Do not calculate from charges or infer route, mass, or vehicle class.
